convert_notebook_to_readme: pipe a jupyter notebook json to gen_readme.py to convert it into a markdown readme
join_indent_elems: use join_indent to join a list of strings with a consistent indent prefix and trailing newlines
extract_code_cell_output: extract code cell outputs from a jupyter notebook json and append them as indented text
render_markdown_cells: render markdown cells from a jupyter notebook json to stdout as plain text
filter_shell_commands: skip code cells containing shell commands starting with exclamation mark when generating readme output
